theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_att_blowUp_points_of_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (x w : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → w ∈ Q → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∃ lam₀ : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < lam₀ → ∃ y ∈ M ∩ N, ‖lam⁻¹ • (y - x) - w‖ < s
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
